calculation.expression: if mean_i(abs(ret_3_i-median(ret_3))) > median_i(abs(ret_3_i)), then -(ret_3_i-median(ret_3))/(std20_i(ret_daily)*sqrt(3)), else missing
calculation.description: When cross-asset three-day dispersion is elevated, favor reversal of each instrument's volatility-normalized three-day shock; otherwise suppress the signal.

parameters.dispersion_gate: mean absolute deviation of 3d returns > cross-sectional median absolute 3d return

validation.regime_notes: Elevated-dispersion observations across multiple regimes; small cross-section interpreted conservatively. Daily paper IC and ICIR exceed benchmark gates of 0.0070 and 0.0840.
validation.provenance: Executed cross-sectional Spearman IC on 15 tradable benchmark instruments; no future data used.
